text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going out with Mayano 
Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Trainer-chan, do you ever watch 
livestreams online?"
choice_data_list: What's with you all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Guess what, Maya started streaming too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Dancing to trending songs~, playing games 
with Teio-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm having tons of fun doing all sorts of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at this, Trainer-chan! Come 
on, look! Look!

Swayed by Mayano Top Gun's sheer 
enthusiasm, I promised to watch her next 
stream.

Later on, when I opened Mayano Top Gun's 
stream channel—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Landing right into everyone's hearts! ☆ 
Mayachin Channel is about to begin~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Today's guest is my good pal, Mave-chin!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo☆ Is everyone feeling MARVELOUS?

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Listener A: We've been waiting for you, 
Maya-chin~!! Listener B: I don't really 
get it, but MARVELOUS! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the comments~! Maya was waiting 
for everyone too♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Today, the two of us are gonna storm a 
totally MARVELOUS place!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Here we go~! Teacup ride top speed 
chaaaallenge!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha~☆ Spinning round and round is so 
marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the arcade! I'm gonna beat 
Teio-chan's high score!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yay☆ An ultra score is so marvelouuus★

Even after that, the two visited all kinds 
of spots, playing with boundless energy 
and delighting their listeners.

Bright as the sun, with a charisma that 
draws everyone in—

"Through the stream, I feel like I was 
able to rediscover Mayano Top Gun's charm 
all over again."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oops, is it time to say goodbye already? I 
wonder if everyone had fun?

In response to Mayano Top Gun's question, 
before I knew it, I had sent in a comment.
choice_data_list: I had so much fun just watching!

I'm always rooting for you. Good luck in 
your race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we could bring all that 
excitement and thrills straight to you 
through the screen♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Getting your comment makes Maya super, 
super happy too! ☆

Mayano Top Gun's smile as she said that 
was truly sparkling and bright.

I resolved in my heart to continue 
supporting her so that I could keep seeing 
this smile.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! Maya isn't just a cute girl, 
after all♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A mature lady has many faces, and I'll 
show you all of them in the race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-h-a-t-'s why☆ You've gotta cheer for 
both my races and my streams♪

I know all too well Mayano Top Gun's charm 
as a competitor.

I wanted the listeners who only knew her 
through her streams to see her shining on 
the racetrack as well.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Trainer-chan, did you watch 
yesterday's stream?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat~!? Could it be this person~?!

The comment Mayano Top Gun pointed out was 
indeed the one I had written.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, was Maya right?
choice_data_list: Amazing! You figured it out well.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I got that all fluffy and warm feeling 
inside, just like when I'm with you, 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we're always together, so you 
could've just told me directly~♪

Despite her words, Mayano Top Gun looked 
quite pleased with herself.
